activity.planned.title: What the finished screen will do
activity.add.title: Add activity
activity.add.intro: Pick the kind of activity you are about to do.
activity.start.title: Start activity
activity.start.hr.title: Live heart rate
activity.start.hr.body: While the activity runs you see your live heart rate and the zone it falls in, based on your maximum heart rate.
activity.live.maxHr: Zones use your heart rate reserve between {rest} and {value} bpm
activity.gps.title: Live route
activity.details.title: Activity
activity.share.title: Share
activity.share.intro: Turn an activity into an image you can share. It is made on your phone and nothing is uploaded.
activity.share.field.name: Name
activity.share.nameHint: Your own name for this activity. Off by default.
activity.share.error: The image could not be made or shared. Try again.
activity.edit.title: Edit activity
loadx.target.title: Your usual load
loadx.target.how.title: Where this range comes from
loadx.target.how.body: The range is your own average load over the previous days, plus and minus one standard deviation. It needs a few days of data first.
loadx.target.advice.title: Based on your readiness today
loadx.target.advice.lower: Your readiness is low today. A load in the lower half of your usual range fits better.
loadx.target.advice.middle: Your readiness is medium today. A load in the middle of your usual range fits.
loadx.target.advice.upper: Your readiness is high today. You have room for a load in the upper half of your usual range.
loadx.target.advice.unknown: There is no readiness for today yet, so there is no advice.
loadx.target.live: Start an activity to follow your Load for today against this range while you train.
loadx.trends.title: Load trends
loadx.trends.loadDayNote: A load day is a day with a load of 7 or more.
loadx.week.title: Weekly overview
steps.noGoal: You have not set a steps goal. Set one in your profile.
steps.hcDays: Days from Health Connect: {count}. The band had no steps on those days. A day with band steps always shows the band.
plan.title: Weekly plan
plan.none.title: No plan yet
plan.none.body: Choose how many load days and well-slept nights you aim for each week. Your progress is counted from your own data.
plan.goal.loadDetail: A day counts when its load is {threshold} or higher.
plan.setup.loadDaysHint: Days with a load of {value} or more
plan.setup.note: The plan is stored on this phone only.
plan.weekly.title: Weekly report
plan.weekly.intro: The last {count} days compared with the 7 days before.
plan.monthly.title: Monthly report
plan.monthly.intro: The last {count} days compared with the 30 days before.
plan.report.tooFew: There are only {count} days of data in this period. A report needs at least {needed}.
plan.report.noPrevious: There are too few days before this period to compare.
plan.report.loadDaysSentence: {count} of {total} days had a load of 7 or more.
plan.report.note: The numbers come from your own days on this phone. This is not medical advice.
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.stepsGoalHint: Between 1,000 and 50,000. Leave empty for no goal.
profile.lifetimeNote: Counted over {days} days of data on this phone.
profile.ach.streak: {count} days of data in a row
activity.notFound.title: Activity not found
activity.notFound.body: This workout is not in your data. It may have been recomputed after a sync.
calories.title: Calories
calories.method: Estimated from your heart rate and body profile. Minutes at or above {threshold} bpm use the heart rate equations of Keytel et al. (2005). All other minutes use resting energy from the Mifflin-St Jeor equation (1990). This is an own method, not comparable to other apps, and not a medical measurement.
calories.coverage: Heart rate covered {percent}% of this day. Minutes without heart rate count as rest, so the real value may be higher.
calories.other: Your sex is set to 'other', so OpenHoop uses the average of the equations for men and women.
calories.needsProfile: Calories need your height, weight, sex and birth year (age 18 to 100).
activity.deleted: Activity deleted. You can undo this for {seconds} s.
activity.dayLoadNote: Your day's Load counts every minute of heart rate once, so an activity that overlaps a detected workout does not add the same minutes twice.
activity.form.hint: Times are in 24-hour format, for example 07:30. An end before the start means the next morning, up to 12 hours later.
activity.form.failed: The activity could not be saved.
activity.form.error.date: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD.
activity.form.error.start: Enter the start time as HH:MM.
activity.form.error.end: Enter the end time as HH:MM.
activity.form.error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start. An end before the start counts as the next day only within 12 hours.
activity.form.error.future: The activity cannot end in the future.
activity.form.error.tooShort: An activity lasts at least one minute.
activity.form.error.tooLong: An activity lasts at most 24 hours.
activity.add.formIntro: When did you do it? Load and heart rate zones come from the heart rate the band recorded in that time.
activity.add.hrNote: If the band recorded no heart rate in that time, the activity is still saved and shows why there is no Load. After the next sync the values are filled in.
activity.start.saved: When you stop, the session is saved as an activity with its Load and zone split.
activity.live.saved: The session is saved. Its heart rate also counts toward your Load for today.
activity.live.tooShort: The session lasted less than a minute, so it was not saved.
activity.live.target.title: Load today with this session
activity.live.target.noBand: There is no target yet: your usual range needs a few days of Load first.
activity.live.target.noDay: Your usual range is {low} to {high}, but there is no Load for today yet, so progress cannot be shown. The Load above is this session alone.
activity.live.target.body: An estimate: today's Load so far plus the heart rate of this session. It is recalculated after the session.
activity.error.noBand: Activities belong to the data of a band. Pair a band or use the demo band first.
activity.error.invalid: This activity is not valid and was not saved.
activity.details.dayLoad: The heart rate in this activity is part of your day's Load. Each minute is counted once.
activity.details.noHr: The band recorded no heart rate in this time, so there is no Load or zone split. The activity itself is saved.
activity.details.lowCoverage: The band recorded heart rate for less than half of this time, which is too little for a Load.
activity.edit.detectedNote: The band detected this workout. Your changes are stored next to it; the detected record itself is kept.
loadScreen.pill.calibrating: Your target appears after a few days of load
loadScreen.advice.below: At {readiness}% readiness, about {low}–{high} min in zone 2–3 lands you inside today's target.
loadScreen.advice.belowOne: At {readiness}% readiness, about {minutes} min in zone 2–3 lands you inside today's target.
loadScreen.advice.belowNoReadiness: About {low}–{high} min in zone 2–3 lands you inside your usual range.
loadScreen.advice.belowOneNoReadiness: About {minutes} min in zone 2–3 lands you inside your usual range.
loadScreen.advice.within: You're inside today's target. Easy movement keeps you there; a hard session would take you past the top.
loadScreen.advice.above: You're past the top of today's target. Keep the rest of the day easy so you recover for tomorrow.
loadScreen.advice.calibrating: Your target needs a few more days of load. Until then, train by feel.
loadScreen.advice.noLoad: There is no load for today yet. Sync your band to see how far you are from today's target.
loadScreen.advice.noEstimate: Your target today is {low}–{high}. There is no time estimate without your resting and maximum heart rate.
loadScreen.zones.title: Heart-rate zones today
loadScreen.calories.caption: kcal · active + resting
loadScreen.levelNote: Cardio load only. Load counts heart-rate minutes, so strength work reads low. It is our own method on a scale of 0 to 21, not comparable to other apps.
loadBuzz.when: Checks after every sync and during a live activity. The band must be connected.
loadBuzz.notSynced: Your band has not synced yet, so nothing has been checked.
loadBuzz.demo: Demo data: the buzz goes to the simulated band, so nothing vibrates.
loadBuzz.noBand: Pair your band first. Until then nothing can buzz.
loadBuzz.calibrating: There is no target yet, so nothing buzzes until your target appears.
loadBuzz.atTarget.title: Buzz when I hit the target
loadBuzz.atTarget.subtitle: One buzz on the band at {low}
loadBuzz.overTop.title: Buzz if I pass the top
loadBuzz.overTop.subtitle: Two buzzes, warns above {high}
term.loadTarget.name: Load target
term.loadTarget.line: The range your Load should land in today: your usual range, narrowed by today's readiness.
term.loadTarget.body: Your load target starts from your usual Load: your average over the previous days, plus and minus one standard deviation. Today's readiness then narrows it: the lower half on a low day, the middle on a medium day and the upper half on a high day. Without readiness the whole usual range counts.
loadTarget.progress.title: Progress to target
loadTarget.estimate: About {minutes} min in zone 2–3 gets you there.
loadTarget.basis: Estimated at {hr} bpm, your usual heart rate in zone 2–3.
loadTarget.reached: You reached today's target. The top is {high}.
loadTarget.above: You passed the top of today's target ({high}).
loadTarget.levelNote: Updates after each sync, and every few seconds during a live activity. Muscular load is not included yet.
stepsScreen.byHourPending: The split per hour appears after the next sync.
stepsScreen.byHourHc: Health Connect only gives a day total, so there is no split per hour for this day.
stepsScreen.byHourEmpty: The band has not counted any steps yet today.
stepsScreen.byHourGap: A dash means the band recorded nothing in that hour.
stepsScreen.levelNote: Counted by the band's own step counter. Accuracy against a reference is not measured yet.
loadTrends.onTargetNote: Days on target count days whose load landed inside that day's own target. Days without a target yet are left out.
loadWeek.title: Week {week}
loadWeek.aboutBody: The chart shows your load and your readiness for each day of the week, each line on its own scale: the top of the chart is 21 for load and 100% for readiness. That lets you see whether hard days followed good nights. The blocks show the same numbers: readiness on top, coloured by its band, and load below. Tap a day to open it.
loadWeek.aboutLoadDays: A load day is a day with a load of 7 or more.
loadWeek.chartA11y: Load and readiness for the week of {range}
loadScreen.advice.belowOpen: At {readiness}% readiness, about {low} min in zone 2–3 gets you into today's target; the top is more than {hours} h away.
loadScreen.advice.belowOpenNoReadiness: About {low} min in zone 2–3 gets you into your usual range; the top is more than {hours} h away.
loadScreen.advice.far: Today's target is more than {hours} h in zone 2–3 away. Every bit of activity still counts.
loadTarget.estimateFar: More than {hours} h in zone 2–3 gets you there.
activity.add.recentNone: Activities you log or record show up here for a quick pick.
activity.start.gps.title: GPS from phone
activity.start.broadcast.title: Broadcast heart rate
activity.start.broadcast.body: Share HR with Zwift, Strava or a bike computer
activity.start.broadcast.noBand: Pair a band to broadcast its heart rate.
activity.start.broadcast.failed: The band did not take the change. Keep it close to the phone and try again.
activity.start.band.title: Band connection
activity.start.band.disconnectedHint: The band also connects when you start. Keep it close to the phone.
activity.live.zoneUnknown: No heart rate yet, so no zone
activity.details.hrNone: No heart rate is stored for this time.
activity.share.transparentNote: A see-through image to lay over your own photo. A saved image keeps the see-through background; some apps add one when you share.
activity.share.routeHiddenAway: Nothing is left of the route with {distance} around the start and the end hidden, so the image shows no route.
activity.share.mapOff: No map background: map tiles need Network features and Maps under Privacy. The route line itself is drawn on the phone.
activity.share.hideEnds: Hide start and end of route
activity.share.hideEndsBody: Leaves out {distance} around where you started and stopped
activity.share.privacyRoute: Only what you switch on is drawn on the image. The time of day is never added, and the route only when Route is on. The image is made on your phone; you choose the folder or app it goes to.
activity.share.saved: The image is saved in the folder you picked.
activity.share.saveError: The image could not be saved there. Pick another folder and try again.
activity.edit.deleteHint: Delete works right away, no need to save first. You can undo for {seconds} seconds.
activity.edit.sliderNeedsTimes: Fill in a valid start and end below to use the time slider.
